tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides a game-theoretic understanding of how workclass contributes to the prediction by assigning additive importance scores. Sensitivity analysis directly evaluates whether masking (ablation) of workclass alters the prediction probability, offering a direct test of the impact. These tools are particularly effective for tabular data and provide both interpretability and empirical evidence on prediction stability when a feature is masked.
